title: Your Leo Friend Is Never Off Stage
topic: Leo zodiac satire: a Leo is never off stage
mechanism: Inside a Leo there is a theater with one SPOTLIGHT switch that only points one way, at her; backstage an APPLAUSE meter must stay in the red, there is a MAIN mirror and a BACKUP mirror, and a big heart with a GENEROUS sign, so she outshines the bride and still pays for everyone's drinks.

beats.hook: Your wedding, under a big LEO sign: Sofia arrives in gold sequins and outshines the bride (you)
beats.story: Sofia brings her own ring light to the ceremony and fixes her hair in the trumpeter's bell during the vows
beats.rise: Her toast is mostly about her; the crowd loves it, the applause meter climbs; Sofia is winning
beats.twist: Lights go down for the first dance; the one spotlight lands on the bride and Sofia stands in the dark for the first time ever
beats.mechanism: Inside her head: a red velvet theater with a SPOTLIGHT switch that only points at her; backstage an APPLAUSE meter in the red, MAIN and BACKUP mirrors, a GENEROUS heart sign and a bar tab she pays for everyone
beats.ending: Sofia walks into the light to dance with the bride, trips on the dress train and lands in the cake; the photographer's flash makes it the best photo of the night

seed.what: Sofia's gold sequin dress (it ends up in the cake in the best photo of the night)
